description: Returns details about a Document Upload

parameters.name: document_upload_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the document upload

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language for the response to be translated into

200.description: Returns details about a Document Upload

latest_event_id.description: Event ID for optimistic concurrency control

integration_statuses.description: Integration statuses for ML and filename scraping services

upload_url.description: A url with which the user can retry a failed upload. This field is returned if and only if the upload status is INCOMPLETE

url_expires_at.description: The expiration for the url found in the upload_url field. This field is returned if and only if the upload status is INCOMPLETE

integrations.description: Information about integration and processing statuses, references, etc.

match_criteria.description: Identifier generated based on naming standard and file format used for grouping documents into containers.

upload_completed_at.description: The date and time when the document upload was completed.

400.description:
Bad Request

Possible reason codes:
- MISSING_REQUIRED_PROPERTY
- INVALID_PROPERTY

404.description:
Not Found

Possible reason codes:
- NOT_FOUND
